home.tagline_b: if I can, you can too.
home.about_body: illusd is a Vibe Coding article platform for people starting from zero. We document the process of learning to code, building products and writing articles so anyone — at any age — can follow along and ship their first work. Read articles, comment, subscribe to new-article notifications, or sign in to chat with the creators directly.

editor.title: Write Article
editor.format_hint: Use this format and we'll auto-split episode / title / topic.
editor.topic_hint: Pick an existing series or create a new one.
editor.help_markdown:
===== Headings =====
# H1 (use once per article)
## H2 for sections
### H3 for subsections

===== Inline =====
**bold**  __also bold__
*italic*  _also italic_
~~strikethrough~~
`inline code`

===== Blockquote =====
> Single-line quote
>
> Second paragraph
>> Nested quote

===== Lists =====
- Unordered item A
- Unordered item B
  - Child item

1. Ordered item one
2. Ordered item two
   1. Nested ordered item

- [ ] Todo
- [x] Done

===== Links & Images =====
This is a [link](https://illusd.com "hover title")
Autolink: <https://illusd.com>
Reference link: see [docs][doc]

[doc]: https://illusd.com/terms-of-service

Image:
![Alt text](https://example.com/cover.jpg)

Clickable image:
[![Alt text](https://example.com/thumb.jpg)](https://illusd.com)

===== Tables =====
| Field | Center | Right |
| :--- | :---: | ---: |
| A | C | 1 |
| B | C | 22 |

===== Code Blocks =====
```js
function greet(name) {
  console.log(`hello ${name}`);
}
```

```python
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
```

===== Horizontal Rule =====
---

===== Escape / Line Break =====
Show literal stars: \*not italic\*
Leave a blank line between paragraphs; add two spaces at line end for a line break.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page is maintained by illusd to explain how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. By using this service, you agree to the practices below.
privacy.account: Email address, display name, and avatar. If you sign in with Google, we also receive your basic public Google profile.
privacy.content: Articles, comments, likes, uploaded files, and short-link targets you post.
privacy.usage: IP address, browser information, action timestamps, and captcha records for risk control.
privacy.payment: When you support us through Ko-fi, payment information is processed by Ko-fi. We do not store credit card or payment account data.
privacy.use_1: Provide and maintain core service features.
privacy.use_2: Send system emails such as verification, password reset, and support notifications.
privacy.use_3: Detect abnormal traffic and block automated abuse.
privacy.use_4: Improve service quality and content recommendations.
privacy.third_party: This service currently uses Supabase (database and authentication), Cloudflare (domain and protection), Google (OAuth sign-in), Ko-fi (support payments), and Lovable (deployment). Each provider has its own privacy policy.
privacy.cookies: We use necessary localStorage to maintain sign-in state. We do not place advertising tracking cookies unless you actively interact with such services.
privacy.rights_prefix: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time. Contact us at
privacy.rights_suffix: and we will respond within a reasonable period.
privacy.retention: Account data is retained until you request deletion; system logs are usually kept for 90 days; violation records may be kept longer to prevent repeated abuse.
privacy.children: We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. If we become aware of such data, we will delete it promptly.
privacy.updates: If this policy changes, we will publish the update on this page and change the last updated date. Material changes may also be announced in-app or by email.
